high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @Civixplorer. The tweet is titled "Naming traditions across the world." It features a map of the world with different regions colored in various shades to represent different naming traditions. Map: The map covers the entire world, showing continents and countries. Different regions are shaded in various colors, each representing a specific naming tradition. The legend at the bottom of the map explains what each color signifies: Red: Given name Orange: Given name + Father's surname + Mother's surname
